import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    public static int powerMod(int base, int exp) {
        if (exp == 1) return base;
        int half = powerMod(base, exp / 2);
        long result = ((long) half * half) % MOD;
        if (exp % 2 == 0) return (int) result;
        return (int) ((result * base) % MOD);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int base = sc.nextInt();
        int exponent = sc.nextInt();

        if (exponent == 0) {
            System.out.println(powerMod(base, base - 1));
            return;
        }

        if (exponent == 1) {
            System.out.println(powerMod(base, base));
            return;
        }

        int multiple = 1;
        int temp = exponent;
        while (true) {
            multiple++;
            temp = (int) (((long) temp * exponent) % base);
            if (temp == 1) {
                System.out.println(powerMod(base, (base - 1) / multiple));
                return;
            }
        }
    }
}
